sources: Owner-approved Saraswati twin cities plan, 14 November 2026
name: Hutel

lines.text: Hutel, from the western coast. Elamite is the language of my first household; Harappan is the language I use with most boats here.
Lothal is across the sea. The boat waits in fresh water while the tide makes up its mind.
The boat has room. We wait for water, never for somebody to finish a notebook.
The fresh channel gives the boat room to wait while the tide changes. There is no notebook toll on leaving.
The work you helped us understand is keeping this place useful.
From your description it turned with the coastal air. I heard reports from the west; I will keep your sighting separate from those.

notes: Western Elamite landing keeper, formerly displayed as Oru. Hutel is a coined game name following the simplified Elamite-inspired sound brief, not an asserted historical attestation. Stable NPC ID retained.
